sample.about: Outside research (Brandon Oct 31 9:35 PM, updated Nov 1 12:14 AM): official park acres by agency (US + Canada). Agencies = list page / download per agency; Acres not downloadable = sizes copied by hand. Waiting room + chat 11 before use.

Agencies.Notes: NPS Land Resources Division quarterly acreage report (XLSX). Sheet 'Listing of Acreage' = 436 units; also 'NPS Fee Acres' / 'Subtotal Federal Acres' columns; sheets 'Acreage by State' and 'Summary of Acreage'. Earlier quarters on same page.

Agencies.Size column name: NFS Acreage (also Other Acreage, Total Acreage)
Agencies.Notes: Land Areas of the National Forest System FY2025, LAR_FY2025.xlsx in the USFS public Box folder linked from the LAR page (data as of 9/30/2025, refreshed 10/24/2025). Sheet T04 'Areas by State' = 363 unit-by-state rows; T03 by region; T07 wilderness by state (622 rows); T13 wild & scenic rivers; T15 NRAs; T18 national monuments. Book PDF and per-table PDFs in same Box folder (FY2025).

Annual Report of Lands (Statistical Data Tables) as of 9/30/2025, PDF only (text-based; reads cleanly with pdftotext -layout). Table 3 = National Wildlife Refuges by state/unit, Grand Total 573 refuges; Table 4 = Waterfowl Production Areas by county; Table 3A = marine monuments. No CSV/XLSX version found.

Agencies.Size column name: BLM-Administered Lands (Acres); wilderness table: BLM Acres
Agencies.Notes: BLM Public Land Statistics 2025 (PDF, 29 MB, text-based). Tables 5-2 (31 National Monuments), 5-3a (19 NCAs), 5-3b (6 other units), 5-4 (263 designated wilderness areas) on pp. 189-208; 5-5 WSAs (491, not itemised per unit with acres here). Count 319 = 31+19+6+263. Same NM/NCA units as a web table: https://www.blm.gov/programs/national-conservation-lands/about/maps-data-and-resources/NM-Detail-Table
